heading: Type + binding
text:
### Type + binding [RLOW.5.1]

A pattern `<Schema>` or `<Schema> <var>` with no `where` compiles to an
`AlphaNode` over `<Schema>` with no tests ([IRET.6]) and a
`BetaNode` with no join test. A read of its binding is a `VarExpr`
([RLOW.4.4.1]).

idris.name: rlow_5_1__pos_kinds
idris.note: The positive patterns' kinds, in order: each bare pattern is its alpha's schema.

idris.name: rlow_5_1__pos_kinds_node
idris.note: One node's positive kind is the same under alphas of one shape, given the rest.

idris.name: rlow_5_1__pos_kinds_same
idris.note: The positive kinds a chain lowers to are the same under alphas of one shape.
